items.title: Jackass: Best and Last
items.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

items.title: A Child of My Own
items.overview: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

items.title: 1000 Men and Me: The Bonnie Blue Story
items.overview: Adult content creator Bonnie Blue announced that she’d slept with 1057 men in 12 hours. Exploring the polarising debate around Bonnie and the pornification of our society, the film follows her over the most eye-opening six months of her life.

items.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
items.overview: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

items.title: Operación Palace
items.overview: Finally, 33 years later, the whole truth behind the attempted coup d'état that shook Spain on the afternoon of February 23, 1981, is revealed by those who lived through those dreadful hours; a deep look behind the heavy curtain which hides the real mastermind, waiting to be unmasked.

items.title: Jackass Number Two
items.overview: Jackass Number Two is a compilation of various stunts, pranks and skits, and essentially has no plot. Chris Pontius, Johnny Knoxville, Steve-O, Bam Margera, and the whole crew return to the screen to raise the stakes higher than ever before.

items.title: Jackass 3D
items.overview: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. items.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
items.overview: A celebration to the group's new era and the fans who made it possible. Features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Eyekons fan videos, and intimate interviews with the members.

items.title: Euphoria: A Look Back
items.overview: The cast and crew of HBO's Euphoria take an exclusive look back at the critically acclaimed series' origins, evolution, and influences.

items.title: A Toxic Love Story
items.overview: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

items.title: A Village Romance
items.overview: Set in a small Hungarian village that was once a popular lesbian community, Bodis Kriszia's documentary chronicles the tumultuous love story between two women and their struggle to live together as a couple. items.title: Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me
items.overview: After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness. This uniquely raw and intimate documentary spans her six-year journey into a new light.

items.title: The Last Scene
items.overview: The story of an indigenous Ese’eja child facing the death of his grandfather. During the two days that separate the two traditional funerals the child decides to go for the first time to the city, to chase his grandfather dream and set his spirit free.

items.title: Ghost Elephants
items.overview: In Angola's mist-shrouded highlands, three KhoiSan master trackers embark on a spiritual quest to rediscover the legendary "ghost elephants" of Lisima, creatures presumed lost but remembered in ancestral trance, ritual, and memory.

items.title: ANNA ASTI. Path of the Phoenix
items.overview: The story of pop singer ANNA ASTI.

items.title: Cosmic Disclosure
items.overview: For the first time ever, a 30-year insider has come forward to reveal over 70 years of humanity's hidden history in space. Corey Goode joins David Wilcock in this inaugural presentation of Cosmic Disclosure to offer an overview of the history and extent of humanity's celestial presence.

items.title: Know How...
items.overview: Get the know how to make technology work for you. TWiT shows you tech projects that you can do yourself and explains everything from tech basics to advanced techniques.

items.title: NOVA
items.overview: PBS' premier science series helps viewers of all ages explore the science behind the headlines. Along the way, NOVA demystifies science and technology, and highlights the people involved in scientific pursuits.

items.title: 37 Grad
items.overview: 37° reports on typical life situations in our society from an unusual perspective: the camera accompanies a group or individual people, usually in a particularly exposed social situation. The reportage often outlines a turning point or a decision-making phase in the biography under review.

items.title: Panorama
items.overview: Current affairs programme, featuring interviews and investigative reports on a wide variety of subjects.

items.title: Mayday
items.overview: Major real-life air disasters are depicted in this series. Each episode features a detailed dramatized reconstruction of the incident based on cockpit voice recorders and air traffic control transcripts, as well as eyewitnesses recounts and interviews with aviation experts.

items.title: Bares für Rares
items.overview: In the show, selected applicants each present a curiosity, rarity or antique they have brought with them. items.overview: Vetenskapens värld is a popular science TV documentary program broadcast on Swedish Television (SVT).

items.title: Spotlight
items.overview: Profiles and interviews with sports personalities.

items.title: Horizon
items.overview: Horizon tells amazing science stories, unravels mysteries and reveals worlds you've never seen before.

items.title: Oddity Archive
items.overview: The Oddity Archive is a web series that revolves around the "cultural dustbin", especially as it pertains to media. items.title: Cuisines des terroirs
items.overview: A sensual approach to culinary art "on the ground", meeting farmers, winegrowers, restaurateurs and cooks, where gastronomy and the art of living have their roots.

items.title: BBC Proms
items.overview: The World's Greatest Classical Music Festival. items.title: Dateline
items.overview: Dateline NBC, or simply Dateline, is a weekly American television newsmagazine series. It was previously the network's flagship newsmagazine, but now focuses mainly on true crime stories with only occasional editions that focus on other topics.

items.title: A Girl's Guide to 21st Century Sex
items.overview: A Girl's Guide to 21st Century Sex is a documentary TV series about sex, which ran in eight episodes on Channel 5 and was presented by Dr Catherine Hood.
